title: Family communication and reunification card
dek: A compact fold-over wallet card for your out-of-area contact, meeting places and school pick-up reminders, with a minimal version for privacy. Free, local-only, prints at true size.
description: Make a free wallet-size family communication and reunification card with an out-of-area contact and meeting places. Minimal privacy version. Nothing is stored.
recheck: If Ready.gov, the CDC or FEMA revise their reunification pages, and before each school year.

source_use.shelter-fcc-comms: Designate an out-of-area person as a central contact (older, undated guide).
source_use.shelter-ready-evacuation: Out-of-state contact in the family communications plan; update the meeting place.
source_use.shelter-cdc-reunification: Meeting spot, children's contact cards, memorize numbers, learn school procedures, NCMEC hotline.
source_use.shelter-ready-tech: Text messages use less bandwidth and are transmitted more reliably.
source_use.shelter-ready-plan: Reconnect plan; familiar easy-to-find meeting place; document and practice.
source_use.shelter-ready-plan-form: Fields of Ready.gov's fillable plan; not saved by any government agency.
source_use.shelter-co-oss-reunification: One state's example of parent guidance; not universal.
source_use.shelter-ncmec-hotline: NCMEC's own listing of its 24-hour hotline number.
source_use.shelter-fema-reunification: National reunification support; archived content; Presidential declaration trigger.
